run_context.report_type: AVSHUNTER US Economic Event Impact Report
run_context.coverage: New material developments since the previous completed run

regime_summary.core_narrative: The State Department spokesperson confirmed an issued Saudi-only departure order for non-emergency staff and families. Reuters still reports possible family departures elsewhere from unnamed officials. The prior alert must not be read as confirmation of a Gulf-wide staff evacuation. US equity closes remained positive.
dominant_drivers: Saudi departure order now confirmed through a named spokesperson reported by Reuters and Anadolu
Scope of other Gulf preparations unresolved
regime_summary.primary_risk: Saudi security risks escalate into energy or shipping disruption
regime_summary.primary_counterforce: Narrower confirmed official scope and resilient US equities

events.event_name: Saudi ordered-departure confirmation and Gulf-scope clarification
events.revision_status: Named spokesperson confirms Saudi order; official scope narrowed
events.timing_limitation: Exact publication time of spokesperson statement and Reuters update unavailable. Original article timestamp is not the clarification time.
events.actual: Named State Department spokesperson confirms departure order for non-emergency US government employees and family members in Saudi Arabia only. Reuters separately attributes possible family departures from other Gulf missions to four unnamed officials.
events.previous: Prior alert described preparations across Gulf embassies and lacked confirmation of any issued order.
events.surprise_direction: Saudi action confirmed; wider official scope narrower than the earlier regional scenario
events.score_method: Uncalibrated heuristic significance of clarification, not a probability
events.evidence_quality: Medium-high: named official statement reproduced by Reuters and Anadolu; original X post not directly retrieved
events.definition: Ordered departure is a compulsory staffing-security measure for designated personnel. The confirmed order covers non-emergency personnel and their families in Saudi Arabia.
events.why_it_matters_to_us_markets: Correcting the geographic scope limits the broad regional escalation scenario used in assessing energy, inflation and volatility risk, while the Saudi order still signals material security concerns.
confirmed_facts: Reuters and Anadolu reproduce the Saudi-only description from spokesperson Tommy Pigott.
The prior unconfirmed preparations status has changed to a confirmed Saudi order.
unresolved: Preparations affecting family members at other Gulf missions
Whether any incremental physical energy supply disruption follows
events.attribution_limitation: Closing values are session outcomes, not measured reactions to the clarification. Earnings and other drivers overlapped.

sources.role: Updated original reporting and named official confirmation
